status: READY FOR MANUAL IPHONE QA; real iPhone execution NOT RUN
environment: Isolated synthetic PostgreSQL + local standalone Next + restricted HTTPS Cloudflare Quick Tunnel. No Production DB or integrations.
record: Screenshots and observed result for every step
setup: Open the isolated QA URL in Safari and authenticate with the supplied synthetic QA account.
Use Share > Add to Home Screen. Launch from the new Home Screen icon, without Safari browser chrome.
For first-launch checks use a fresh installation/storage state. Confirm the default Light theme. Keep existing CRM safe-area and navigation layout.

checks: First launch: photograph the area around clock, battery, signal and notch/Dynamic Island. Compare with the CRM top background.
Confirm dark clock/system icons remain readable on the light background.
Switch from Dark and Slate to Light while the standalone app stays open; verify background and contrast.
Close the app normally, reopen from the Home Screen, then force-close/reopen. Verify Light is restored without a bright/dark startup mismatch or overlap.
Select Dark through the existing More > Theme control. Observe the system status area and CRM top boundary.
Confirm white clock/system icons remain readable. Record if the native area is opaque black rather than the configured CRM color.
Switch Light -> Dark -> Slate -> Dark without leaving standalone mode; check contrast after each transition.
Close/reopen normally and force-close/reopen. Verify saved Dark theme restores at first visible frame and content does not move under the status area.
Select Slate through More > Theme and photograph the status area next to the CRM background.
Confirm white clock/system icons remain readable; record any black-to-slate seam.
Switch Light -> Slate -> Dark -> Slate; verify contrast, theme persistence and no safe-area shift.
Close/reopen normally and force-close/reopen. Verify Slate restores immediately without a Light flash.

additional: Repeat on Case Detail and Dashboard. Verify original header/controls/bottom navigation positions.
Show/dismiss keyboard, rotate portrait/landscape and return from background after <45 s and >45 s. Check no notch overlap or navigation clipping.
For every theme capture cold launch, live switch and reopen screenshots. Mark PASS/FAIL per step; do not infer hardware PASS from metadata or browser emulation.
acceptance: Readable system icons, stable theme on launch/switch/reopen, no unexpected white/cyan area, no CRM content or navigation shift. Exact native iOS background behavior must be observed; configuration alone does not guarantee a hex color or live status-bar update.
availability: Keep this computer awake, Docker and QA app/tunnel running. Temporary URL stops with the tunnel. Credentials supplied in the user report, stored only outside Git.
shortManualChecklist: Safari: open QA URL, log into the synthetic tenant, Share > Add to Home Screen; launch from Home Screen. Log in again if iOS requests it. Open IPHONE-QA-001.
A: switch Light, Dark, Slate; inspect clock/battery/notch area and legibility; close/reopen each theme. Record actual iOS limitations.
B: Case at top: pull down, see indicator, release; data refreshes and route stays the same.
C: edit notes without Save, wait Saved, back/reopen and verify. Repeat status and personalAppearanceNote (Important dates > personal visit note); reload/reopen confirms each value.
D: edit a field and immediately press Save; reopen and verify value.
E: background CRM for more than 45 seconds, return; verify data refreshes. Keep form clean for this check; dirty inputs must remain protected.
